mission.title: opentelemetry: GKE Autopilot allowlist onboarding
mission.description: OpenTelemetry Collector DaemonSet pods are rejected on GKE Autopilot clusters because Autopilot's warden webhook blocks host ports, read-only hostPath mounts, and custom node affinities by default (e.g. "autogke-no-write-mode-hostpath" violations). Requested by 6+ users; fixed by onboarding OpenTelemetry into the GKE Autopilot partner workload allowlist program.

steps.title: Check current opentelemetry deployment
steps.description:
Verify your opentelemetry version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n opentelemetry -l app.kubernetes.io/name=opentelemetry
helm list -n opentelemetry 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working opentelemetry installation.

steps.title: Review opentelemetry configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant opentelemetry configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n opentelemetry -l app.kubernetes.io/name=opentelemetry
kubectl get configmap -n opentelemetry -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=opentelemetry
```
Grafana Beyla, which has been donated to OTel as OBI (https://opentelemetry.io/docs/zero-code/obi/), is already allowlisted by GKE Autopilot via the partner workload allowlist program, so the OpenTelemetry Collector follows the same `WorkloadAllowlist` onboarding path.

steps.title: Apply a GKE Autopilot WorkloadAllowlist for the OpenTelemetry Collector
steps.description:
Create a `WorkloadAllowlist` that exempts the OpenTelemetry Collector DaemonSet from the Autopilot restrictions it needs to operate, then sync it into the cluster with an `AllowlistSynchronizer`:
```yaml
apiVersion: auto.gke.io/v1
kind: WorkloadAllowlist
metadata:
  name: opentelemetry-collector-daemonset-exemptions
  annotations:
    autopilot.gke.io/no-connect: "true"
exemptions:
# Allow host ports for node-local OTLP traffic between monitored workloads and the
# OpenTelemetry collector DaemonSet pod on the same node.
- autogke-no-host-port
# Allow read-only host volume mount of "/" for the OpenTelemetry host metrics receiver,
# which requires mounting the node's file system as a read-only volume.
- autogke-no-write-mode-hostpath
# Allow custom node affinities, required if users configure the collector's affinity settings.
- autogke-node-affinity-selector-limitation
```
Apply it and verify the allowlist is accepted:
```bash
kubectl apply -f workload-allowlist.yaml
kubectl get workloadallowlists.auto.gke.io
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n opentelemetry -l app.kubernetes.io/name=opentelemetry
kubectl get events -n opentelemetry --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "GKE Autopilot allowlist onboarding" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary: The OpenTelemetry Collector DaemonSet failed to schedule on GKE Autopilot because Autopilot's warden webhook rejects host ports, hostPath volume mounts, and custom node affinities by default. The fix works because GKE Autopilot's partner workload allowlist program lets a vendor-published WorkloadAllowlist exempt specific workloads from those restrictions: onboarding OpenTelemetry (alongside the already-allowlisted Grafana Beyla/OBI) publishes exemptions for autogke-no-host-port, autogke-no-write-mode-hostpath, and node-affinity limits, so the collector's node-local OTLP host port and read-only "/" host metrics mount are admitted.

apiVersion: auto.gke.io/v1
kind: WorkloadAllowlist
metadata:
  name: opentelemetry-collector-daemonset-exemptions
  annotations:
    autopilot.gke.io/no-connect: "true"
exemptions:
# Allow host ports for node-local OTLP traffic between monitored workloads and the
# OpenTelemetry collector DaemonSet pod on the same node.
- autogke-no-host-port
# Allow read-only host volume mount of "/" for the OpenTelemetry host metrics receiver,
# which requires mounting the node's file system as a read-only volume.
- autogke-no-write-mode-hostpath
# Allow custom node affinities, required if users configure the collector's affinity settings.
- autogke-node-affinity-selector-limitation

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with opentelemetry installed or the issue environment reproducible.
